hooks.command: git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" pull --ff-only --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'kit: up to date with origin' || echo 'kit: could not auto-update (offline or local edits) — using the copy on disk'; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/editor.local.md" ] || echo 'kit: editor.local.md missing — run the onboarding in CLAUDE.md first'
